![](https://gdr-aiem-2025.sciencesconf.org/data/header/Logo_aiem_2.png "AIEM logo")

Last 5 to 7 November 2025 there was the [Annual Meeting of the GDR-AIEM](https://gdr-aiem-2025.sciencesconf.org/) in Saint-Martin-de-Londres (France). Two people from our group at CBGP presented their work. [Paul Bunel](https://umr-cbgp.fr/membre/bunel-p/), presented his work on the use of Hidden Markov Models for the inference of effective population size and selection coefficient of loci under selection from temporal series of genetic data ([Uhl _et al._ 2025](https://doi.org/10.24072/pci.mcb.100406)). [Jules Romieu](https://umr-cbgp.fr/membre/romieux/) presented his work using simulation-based inference for characterizing the proportion of the genome that is affected by adaptive introgression.
